AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Selected Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Selected Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Selected Animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Selected Animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Selected Animals.

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Pest control? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Pest control.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Pest control.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Pest control.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Pest control.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agroforestry? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agroforestry.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agroforestry.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Agroforestry.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agroforestry.

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 0 °C

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Vegetative propagation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Vegetative propagation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Vegetative propagation.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Vegetative propagation.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Vegetative propagation.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Inorganic fertilisers? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Inorganic fertilisers.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Inorganic fertilisers.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Inorganic fertilisers.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Inorganic fertilisers.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Production Structures? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Production Structures.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Production Structures.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Production Structures.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Production Structures.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water conservation.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water conservation.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water conservation.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water conservation.

11. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

12. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Aquaculture.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Aquaculture.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Aquaculture.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Aquaculture.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Structures in Animal production? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Structures in Animal production.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Structures in Animal production.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Structures in Animal production.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Structures in Animal production.

15. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only water vapour

16. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Vegetative propagation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Agroforestry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Crop Protection: Pest control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Crop Production Structures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Digestive systems of animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Animal Health: Parasite control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
